definitions.explanation: A type of thick, chewy wheat flour noodle commonly used in Japanese cuisine, typically served in hot broth or cold with dipping sauce.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冷|つめ}たい→冷たい：00681_tsumetai⟧うどん⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{食|た}べたい→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I want to eat cold udon.

examples.japanese: うどん⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つるつる→つるつる：05175_tsurutsuru⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
{讃岐|さぬき}うどん⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{香川県|かがわけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名物|めいぶつ}→名物：05591_meibutsu⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。

examples.english: At lunchtime I went to the udon shop in front of the station and had tempura udon.

notes:
うどん is one of the most popular traditional Japanese noodle dishes, made from wheat flour. The noodles are thick and chewy, in contrast to the thinner ⟦そば→蕎麦：14329_soba⟧ (buckwheat noodles).

TYPES:
- ⟦{掛|か}け→かける：00854_kakeru⟧うどん: udon in hot broth (the simplest style)
- {釜揚|かまあ}げうどん: freshly boiled udon with dipping sauce
- ⟦ざる→ざる：04470_zaru⟧うどん: cold udon served on a bamboo tray
- ⟦{焼|や}き→焼く：01123_yaku⟧うどん: stir-fried udon
- ⟦{天|てん}ぷら→天ぷら：04948_tenpura⟧うどん: udon topped with tempura

CULTURAL NOTE:
{讃岐|さぬき}うどん from {香川県|かがわけん} is the most famous regional variety. Udon shops (うどん⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧) are widespread and serve as affordable, quick meal spots.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦そば→蕎麦：14329_soba⟧: buckwheat noodles (thinner, often paired as a comparison)
- ⟦ラーメン→ラーメン：05181_raamen⟧: ramen (Chinese-origin wheat noodles in flavored broth)
- ⟦{素麺|そうめん}→素麺：noentry⟧: very thin wheat noodles, usually eaten cold in summer
